remarks: LOCATION!!! This new listing is located in the center of Westport on a quiet street in a walkable neighborhood. This house is sited on over an acre with mature trees creating privacy in the rear yard. Convenient to shopping, trains, and schools, this spacious home offers versatility on 3 levels w/an open layout. Huge windows expose tremendous natural light and give a modern feel. An oversized family room with a vaulted ceiling & a floor to ceiling stone fireplace is the heart of the house. The soaring ceilings in this space are a show stopper.  With 6 bedrooms this house offers flexibility with many options for work from home, long term visiting guests and entertaining. Walk-out lower level includes a playroom, as well as a bedroom and full bath. Huge front yard and ample parking, this home is not to be missed.
